name: Dot & Key Mango Detan Gel Sunscreen SPF 50+ PA+++ 80gm | Oil-Free, With Alpha-Arbutin & Niacinamide | Controls Tanning, Brightens Skin | Fades Dark Spots, Water Resistant | All Skin Types
description:
High Sun Protection Gel Sunscreen SPF50+ PA+++

A lightweight, oil-free gel sunscreen that provides broad-spectrum SPF50+ PA+++ protection against UVA and UVB rays, while helping to reduce tanning and brighten skin tone. Specially formulated for oily, combination, and sensitive skin, it absorbs quickly with no white cast for a comfortable daily wear.

Key Features:

High Sun Protection: SPF50+ and PA+++ for strong UVA/UVB defense

Detanning & Brightening: Powered by Alpha-Arbutin and Niacinamide to reduce pigmentation and tanning

Lightweight Gel Formula: Fast-absorbing, oil-free, non-comedogenic, and fragrance-free

Daily Use: Gentle enough for sensitive skin, perfect for year-round protection

Notable Ingredients:

Alpha-Arbutin: Brightens and evens skin tone, reducing dark spots

Niacinamide (Vitamin B3): Anti-inflammatory, improves skin texture

Tocopheryl Acetate (Vitamin E): Antioxidant protection against environmental stressors

Panthenol (Pro-Vitamin B5): Deeply hydrates and soothes skin
